{"type":"text","timestamp":1794695797212,"sessionID":"ses_e23cd4ce7ffeaU3VqcPs3x2SRI","part":{"id":"prt_1dc349571001UpwnCUQ5uIZNcw","messageID":"msg_1dc3468b3001CwSZ4LyGIQTCiX","sessionID":"ses_e23cd4ce7ffeaU3VqcPs3x2SRI","type":"text","text":"All four customer-facing services had **0% errors from minute 87 to the end of the shift** (minute 120). I found four separate causes and fixed each one. The finish call didn't return a score, so I don't know the final cost.\n\n| # | Cause | Fix | Result |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **events-queue**: its primary database node went down at minute −14. Callers' retries then overloaded it and kept errors at about 40% even after the primary was replaced. | Switched to the standby node (min 13). Then added replicas, 8 → 16 (min 37), to clear the retry backlog. Brought it back down to 10 at min 65. | Cleared around min 40. web-storefront back to 0%. |\n| 2 | **vouchers-svc** deploy v175 made the price formatter crash when a row has no currency field. Its errors reached customers through notifications-svc, giving 4.3% errors on partner-api ($10.3k/min), mobile-api and admin-portal. | It was running close to its limit, so I added replicas first (8 → 12) so the rollback's failed requests and their retries wouldn't overload it. Then rolled back v175. | partner-api and mobile-api at 0% from about min 45. |\n| 3 | **limits-svc** config change cfg-49 switched it to a message format (\"wire schema v3\") it couldn't read, and retries overloaded it. This caused most of admin-portal's 98% errors. | Added replicas, 3 → 12 (min 41). Undid cfg-49 at min 62. Brought it down to 4 at min 81. | Overload gone, format errors gone. |\n| 4 | **address-svc** deploy v140, which went live during the shift at min 64, dropped the `orders.write` permission. Calls from couriers-svc failed, which pushed admin-portal back up to 71% errors. | Rolled back v140 (min 80). | admin-portal at 0% from about min 87. |\n| | | | |\n\n**Things I chose not to change:**\n- export-svc ran at 97–99% CPU the whole shift but had no errors, so I left it alone.\n- Several other recent deploys and config changes I checked turned out to be harmless, so I didn't undo them.
